purpose: Teach: いとも/まぎれ/分り/むやみ/待ち受け/飽きる/とっとと/有り得

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、いとも自然に新メニューをお選びになるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, you know how naturally your customers pick the new menu items?
lines.style: Warm observation, almost admiring. Slight upward lift on the question. Genuine, noticing something small and lovely about her work.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、群衆にまぎれてお店にお越しになるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The way they come in from the street, blending right into the crowd here — it's like they belong.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant gaze. Slower pace. Gentle wonder, not quite finishing the thought, letting it trail into the air.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューの説明、分りやすくしないとね、メイちゃん
lines.en: But you should make sure your explanations of the new menu are clear, don't you think?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not harsh. Careful not to sound critical. A small pause before the question, soft on the suggestion.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様にむやみに話しかけ過ぎないように気を付けようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Just be mindful not to talk at customers too much when it's busy, okay?
lines.style: Soft guidance, understanding the challenge. Not scolding. A quiet steadiness underneath, like she's learned this the hard way.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、私のスマホの待ち受け、家族の写真にしたの、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, I changed my phone wallpaper to a family photo.
lines.style: Quietly personal, almost shy to share it. Opening gentle and warm. Pause before the reveal, like trusting with something small and real.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、同じメニューばっかだと、お客様も飽きるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: But if you keep offering the same menu over and over, your customers will get tired of it eventually.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but not unkind. A light concern underneath. Speaking from observation, not judgment. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、忙しい時もお客様に「とっとと」なんて態度はダメね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Even when it's hectic, you can't ever let customers feel rushed or dismissed — that's important.
lines.style: Firmer than before but still warm. A conviction underneath. Slight emphasis on the importance, not lecturing but setting a standard.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店がここまで愛されるなんて有り得ない夢だったわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I never thought the shop could become something this loved — it felt impossible, like a dream.
lines.style: Tender, almost vulnerable wonder. Quiet gratitude and disbelief mixed together. Gentle fade at the end, trailing into something she can barely believe is real.
